info.name: DAtuviSezaH
info.value: 'sPurja' iti hrasva-ukAreRa-nirdeSe kfte api upaDAyAM ca 8.2.78 ityanena dIrGaH avaSyaM sidDyet . ataH mUlataH eva prayuktaH dIrGaH UkAraH vyarTaH, vyarTa~ san upaDAyAM ca 8.2.78 ityasya anityatvaM jYApayati .

examples: 'astyevaM jaqaDAmatA ca Bavato yad vyomni visPUrjase' (kA0 pra0 10.444).
'kva ca vikrAntatA yAtA kva ca visPUrjitaM mahat' (BA0 Salya0 31.33). visPUrjitaM garjitam, stanitam.
'tatsarvaM suralokadevasadfSaM Darmasya visPUrjitam' (Bartf0 2.125). visPUrjitam PalaM vipAkaH, pariRAmaH.
'DArARAM ca nipAtena vAyorvisPUrjitena ca' (BA0 vana0 186.6). visPUrjitena pracaRqena vegena.
'viSvaM viDvaMsayan vIryaSOryavisPUrjitaBruvA' (BA0 pu0 4.24.57). visPUrjitA''kuYcitA. anyatra durlaBorTaH.
